visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short dark hair wearing a black t-shirt sits on a red sofa, holding a black microphone and performing with expressive mouth movements and hand gestures. Beside him, a woman with long dark hair in a black graphic t-shirt smiles and watches him. A wooden table in the foreground holds a large vase filled with pink and yellow roses. White and black text overlays are displayed at the top center. (2) The man continues his performance, handing a single purple flower to the woman. She takes the flower and her expression shifts from amusement to a skeptical side-eye as she looks at him. The background is a warm-lit living room featuring a piano, a tall lamp, and a full bookshelf. (3) The man finishes his performance and looks at the woman. She leans in with a mock-sweet smile and then suddenly lunges at him with an aggressive facial expression. The man flinches and quickly exits the frame to the left, while the woman remains on the sofa, gesturing toward the empty space.
